items.text: In Figure 5, which agent is the odd one out, acting directly on the skeletal muscle fiber rather than within the central nervous system?

emphasis.text: Dantrolene.

items.text: Why:  Dantrolene decreases calcium release from the skeletal muscle sarcoplasmic reticulum, acting directly on the muscle fiber — unlike cyclobenzaprine, tizanidine, and baclofen, which all act within the CNS to reduce excitatory output to motor neurons.
